worldcombat.skill.poltergeist.summary: Seize the target's held item from afar, wrench it out of its hand and hurl it back at its owner; the move cannot work if the target carries nothing. Stronger telekinesis reaches further.
worldcombat.skill.poltergeist.use.0: Turn the target's own item against it from range
worldcombat.skill.poltergeist.use.1: Deal with a target holding a powerful item
worldcombat.skill.poltergeist.use.2: With bind on, cling to and slow the target
worldcombat.skill.poltergeist.descriptio: The hurl deals about %1$s Ghost damage with a %2$s block hit radius; the move makes no contact, and the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
Manipulate from up to %1$s blocks away; the item returns at %2$s blocks per tick after being wrenched about %3$s blocks off the target's hand.
A landed hit shoves the target about %1$s blocks along the hurl.
worldcombat.skill.poltergeist.bind.on: Item bind on: on a hit the item clings to the target and slows it for %1$s s, at the cost of x0.8 power.
worldcombat.skill.poltergeist.bind.off: Item bind off: the item disperses after the blow, making this a pure heavy hurl.
worldcombat.skill.poltergeist.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.poltergeist.growth.0: At level %1$s, Poltergeist power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.poltergeist.growth.1: At level %1$s, Poltergeist power rises to %2$s and the manipulation range to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.poltergeist.preference: On: on a hit the item clings to the target and slows it for a while, but the blow is x0.8. Off: the item disperses after the blow, making this a pure heavy hurl.
Only manipulates from within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to manipulate from range. Off: it only manipulates when the target is already within range.
